en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Abu Al Magra, 
(It has been narrated) from Mansour Bin Hazim

who asked Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> about a yard between two houses, so he<sup>asws</sup> claimed that Ali<sup>asws</sup> judged for the owner of the house to (allow for) the fence which was facing the other (house)’.
en.sarwar: 3. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from ibn abu ‘Umayr from abu al-Mighra’ from Mansur ibn Hazim who has said the following: “This is concerning my question before abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, about the yard between two houses
and he (the Imam) expressed certainty about the judgment of Ali, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, in such case in favor of the house toward which the fence is facing.’”
